Energy Minister directs DISCOMs to stay on high alert ahead of Cyclone Akvan
 Gottipati Ravi Kumar asks officials to stock essential equipment at vulnerable locations and ensure prompt restoration of power supply in cyclone-affected areas
 Updated - November 16, 2026 07:12 pm IST - VIJAYAWADA 
 V. Raghavendra READ LATER 
 SEE ALL 
 Remove 
 Energy Minister Gottipati Ravi Kumar directs officials to ensure that field teams are fully equipped and ready to respond promptly.
 | Photo Credit: File photo
 Energy Minister Gottipati Ravi Kumar has directed officials to remain on high alert and ensure full preparedness to deal with the likely impact of Cyclone Akvan.
 At a high-level review meeting with senior DISCOM officials on Monday to assess measures to safeguard power infrastructure, Mr. Ravi Kumar stressed the need to draw lessons from previous cyclones and strengthen preparedness to minimise damage to the electricity network.
 He instructed officials to ensure that field teams were fully equipped and ready to respond promptly. He directed them to take up restoration works on a war footing in the event of electricity poles being uprooted or power lines snapped due to strong winds and heavy rainfall.
 The Minister also called for adequate stocks of electricity poles, conductors, transformers and other essential equipment to be maintained in advance at vulnerable locations. He stressed the need to mobilise restoration teams promptly to ensure early resumption of power supply in affected areas.
 Emphasising public safety, Mr. Ravi Kumar directed senior officials to closely monitor field operations and ensure the availability of adequate personnel throughout the cyclone period.
 He made it clear that negligence at any level would not be tolerated and called for all precautionary measures to prevent loss of life.
